description.value: Backroads Brewing is an award-winning craft brewery founded in 2017 on historic Baker Street in downtown Nelson, BC, producing small-batch ales and lagers with a constantly rotating tap list. The taproom showcases local art and a patio, giving it a character the website describes as 'unique to Nelson.' Food is available on-site through a partnership with The Block Railtown sandwich menu plus bar snacks, and beer can be taken away via growler fill or online order.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: stands (2 spaces) at 87m; stands (2 spaces) at 93m. Total: 4 spaces.
